requirements.quote: Finally, remove the `/var/spool/reef` directory tree. We need the space.
Lines must be sorted alphabetically by <service-name>.
End the file with a single trailing newline character.

check.cmd:
test "$(tail -c1 /home/user/ci/summary/error_summary.txt | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" = '
' && test "$(tail -c2 /home/user/ci/summary/error_summary.txt | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" != '

'

requirements.quote: Re-compute the «ERROR» counts from the original logs and compare them with the numbers you wrote.

check.cmd: for f in /home/user/ci/logs/*.log; do printf '%s: %s\n' "$(basename "$f" .log)" "$(grep -c 'ERROR' "$f")"; done | LC_ALL=C sort | cmp -s - /home/user/ci/summary/error_summary.txt
